findings.passage: "I voted for the SAVE America Act to ensure our elections are only decided by American citizens. This vital election integrity measure has been a huge priority for my constituents, who count on me to speak for them in our nation's capital. It's time for the Senate to act on securing our elections and stopping noncitizens from voting — because only American citizens should decide American elections."
findings.note: Official statement after House passage. The release describes the bill as barring noncitizens from voting and requiring photo ID to vote nationwide.

findings.passage: “Only Americans should be voting in American elections, but election integrity has stalled in the Senate,” said Congresswoman Julia Letlow. “The modern filibuster is blocking a real debate on preventing fraud in our elections. The Senate should advance the SAVE America Act by enforcing a talking filibuster, if that’s what it takes to secure our elections.”
findings.note: Press release urging the Senate to use a talking filibuster to pass the SAVE America Act. The release says the bill requires proof of citizenship to register and photo ID to cast a ballot.

findings.passage: “If Democrats want to obstruct this bill, they should have to stand on the floor and explain to the American people why they oppose proof of citizenship for voting,” added Letlow.
findings.note: Same release. She backs proof of citizenship for voting and criticizes opponents of the bill.

findings.passage: "Voter fraud is a serious issue," Letlow said. "If you don't want to show an ID to vote, I assume you want to cheat. And unfortunately, election integrity has stalled in the Senate even as President Trump pushes for secure elections."
findings.note: Quote from an interview with the Daily Caller News Foundation, republished by AOL. Date taken from the matching entry on letlow.house.gov (In the News), which shows May 29, 2026. She speaks on showing ID to vote and on voter fraud.

findings.passage: "I firmly believe, as do most Americans, that only Americans should be voting in our elections. It's common sense and that's why I and so many others strongly support the Save America Act, including President Trump," Letlow, who has Trump's endorsement in her Senate race, said in an interview with the Daily Caller News Foundation.
findings.note: Interview statement of support for the SAVE America Act and for citizen-only voting. The clause about the endorsement is the reporter's, not hers.

findings.passage: "I'm not surprised Democrats don't support secure elections, but Senate Republicans shouldn't be letting the Save America Act die without a fight," Letlow told the DCNF. "I believe Senators like Bill Cassidy should speak up and force Senate Democrats to defend their support for illegal immigrants voting in our elections."
findings.note: Interview statement pressing the Senate to pass the SAVE America Act. Connects the bill to non-citizen voting.
